Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and anticipated rate cuts sustain safe-haven premiums.

Silver.note: Photovoltaic demand offsets recent price pullbacks and monetary headwinds.

Copper.note: Structural mine supply deficits and electrification demand drive a tight market.

Uranium.note: Nuclear renaissance and primary supply deficits underpin a strong bull cycle.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and moderating EV demand growth weigh on margins.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply surges and LFP battery substitution create a persistent surplus.

Zinc.note: Mine closures and severe treatment charge squeezes tighten concentrate supply.

Iron Ore.note: Persistent weakness in Chinese property construction caps steelmaking demand.

Coal.note: Ample global inventories and long-term decarbonization pressures offset baseload demand.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical export controls and supply chain decoupling support strategic premiums.

Manganese.note: Steady steelmaking demand balances the market amid niche battery volatility.

PGM.note: South African power constraints and auto-catalyst substitution tighten primary supply.

Potash.note: Geopolitical supply disruptions from Eastern Europe constrain global fertilizer availability.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and rising green demand structurally tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Heavy copper weighting and resilient iron ore earnings provide strong macro optionality.
